reviews.author: David (Arm)
reviews.summary: Reviewer David expressed uncertainty about the proposed fix for a bug on x86, suggesting it may not be acceptable to the x86 community and offered to CC them for their opinion.
reviews.raw_body:
I'm sure x86 folks will have an opinion :) . Let me CC them whether something
like that would be acceptable.

2026-10-27.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the Linux kernel's atomic operations by allowing faults to occur when updating a read-only HVO (Hardware Virtualization Optimization) tail page, rather than attempting to handle speculative gets. The fix involves introducing a new function, arch_atomic_fetch_add_unless_nofault(), which allows faults to be handled instead of oopsing. This change is specific to x86, RISC-V, and LoongArch architectures, which support HVO. The patch has been lightly tested on x86 by hitting a real HVO tail page.
